overview: A mobile-first multi-tenant SaaS that lets wholesale traders publish a shareable product catalog and take orders over WhatsApp.
features: Public zero-login storefront at a shareable link
Product gallery with category filters and instant search
Optional fullscreen virtual shop tour video
Merchant dashboard for store setup and product management
Image and video uploads for products and tours
Share tools with copy link and QR code
Admin panel with active/paused metrics and per-store pause control
Per-store click and WhatsApp order analytics
